basis: OpenStreetMap gives the named enclosure. The north frontage and stepped wing sections are visible in its plan. The 8 November 2016 Qualla exterior shows the shallow steel and glass gable, entry canopy, center pediment, glazed pale foyer and paired stair flights. The companion interior shows the open room and side galleries.
estimates: The north front follows the mapped pedestrian approach. Rear roof breaks, sections, finishing colors under daylight and the built grade are approximate. The paired stairs and truss openings are simplified.
